issues.issue: The AE percentages (muscle spasms 54%, alopecia 53%, dysgeusia 46%, fatigue 41%, nausea 39%, musculoskeletal pain 32%) are stated as percentages in the text but the citation quote shows raw table codes (543, 530, 460, 414, 391, 321); the '≥10%' threshold and the percent interpretation are not literally supported by the cited quote, so these numbers read as uncited.

Population states the efficacy population was '66 patients with laBCC randomized to 200 mg daily,' but cited quotes only state 66 laBCC patients were randomized to 200 mg; claiming them as 'the efficacy population' overstates the citation (and the 200 mg arm total was 79 per the n field).

Result says median duration of response 'not reached'; the supporting quote references 31 patients with ongoing responses ranging '1.9+ to 18.6+ months,' but those specific range numbers are not reflected—acceptable, yet the '82%/31 patients' context is dropped, making the DoR claim thinly supported; verify the DoR citation matches the laBCC 200 mg subgroup.

Citation line 6 is flagged as unverified (OCR stitched header block); however first_cycle_approval value=true is correctly inferred from absence of a prior CRL (crl_history.prior_crl=false), so the value itself is fine—only the quote verification is a concern.
Receipt date citation (line 6) is in unverified_citations (not found verbatim in OCR), so September 26, 2014 is not reliably sourced even though it is likely correct.
Priority_review basis citation (line 6) is flagged as unverified; the standard-review claim rests on an unverifiable stitched quote.

Summary citation (line 6) is flagged as unverified; the summary also calls ODOMZO a 'new molecular entity,' a claim not supported by any citation (modality/approval citations do not state NME status).
Summary states ORR 58% and 'second Hedgehog pathway inhibitor'—both supported by cited quotes (lines 16 and 12), consistent with no accelerated approval; internally consistent.

Text says '151 to 800 mg, 79 to 200 mg' which matches the cited quote, but the trial_name/design quotes repeatedly misrender the study ID as 'A2001' vs 'A2201' (OCR inconsistency); confirm the correct study identifier.
Orphan_drug present=false with no citation; BCC/laBCC may carry an orphan designation—verify the review does not mention orphan status (possible completeness gap).
